items.text: Find the composer in the screenshot and why its controls cannot be selected
Confirm whether the composer controls are dead, on web and desktop
Remove the stray lines (hairline round the desktop composer, divider above the account block) so both surfaces match the web
Rebuild the desktop bundle and verify both lines are gone and nothing else moved
Get confirmation to build and deploy
Delete the previous installer and rebuild the Windows installer
Install the new build and confirm its version
Deploy the web build to Railway and verify the live site
Close the review servers and report
